Its result messages are more useful, it announces progress in a status region, and it turns off the spinner animation for reduced motion. Answer B sends field errors to the shared status line, mostly keeps 'Something went wrong', only slows the spinner for reduced motion, and makes Name required, which nobody asked for. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B places a specific error message directly under the email field and links it with aria-describedby. Its failure messages say the person's details are kept and tell them to try again, and the spinner fully stops when reduced motion is requested. A shows field errors in the shared status line below the button, only slows the spinner for reduced motion, and makes the name required, which the original form did not do. Both keep the layout, apart from B adding one error line and a reserved space for the spinner.
